verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe official client SDKs in seven languages (Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby), plus the ant CLI and framework-specific libraries. The SDKs offer idiomatic interfaces, type safety, streaming, retries and error handling, and latest versions are published as machine-readable JSON. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries
Each SDK provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in support for streaming, retries, error handling
The latest version of each Claude Platform SDK and of the ant CLI is at https://platform.claude.com/docs/sdk-versions.json, as JSON.
